primitives.name: Instinctual Motor Response
primitives.verbatim_quote: But first, what kind of motor reactions upon objects shall we count as instincts?
primitives.assumptions: The response is triggered solely by the presence of a specific external stimulus, without deliberation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when the stimulus is absent or masked by competing signals.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's conformal prediction regions for stimulus-response classification; models the binary outcome as a latent variable.
layer2.telemetry: Electromyographic (EMG) activity or pupil dilation as empirical verification metrics

primitives.name: Reflex Integration
primitives.verbatim_quote: These movements merge into ordinary reflex actions like laughing when tickled, or making a wry face at a bad taste.
primitives.assumptions: Simple sensory-motor loops operate deterministically within a fixed time window.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down under chronic stimulation or neurological damage.

layer2.mapping: Applies GSE's Markov state-transition framework to model the sequence "stimulus → integration → response"; uses reaction time variance as a telemetry metric.
layer2.telemetry: Reaction latency and electromechanical delay as observables

primitives.name: Behavioral Classification
primitives.verbatim_quote: On the whole it is best to be catholic, since it is very hard to draw an exact line ; and call both of these kinds of activity instinctive, so far as either may be naturally provoked by the presence of specific sorts of outward fact.
primitives.assumptions: Instinctive behaviors are categorized by their functional role: self-preservation vs social learning.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Collapses when environmental novelty exceeds species-specific behavioral repertoire.

layer2.mapping: Establishes duality between biological categorization and GSI's Bayesian hypothesis testing; treats each instinct as a distinct likelihood ratio test.
layer2.telemetry: Neural activation patterns in amygdala and premotor cortex

primitives.name: Perceptual Arousal
primitives.verbatim_quote: Such is the bristling up of the attention when a novel object is perceived, or the expression'on the face or the breathing apparatus of an emotion it may excite.
primitives.assumptions: Attentional shifts are driven by salience gradients in sensory input.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Disrupts when cognitive load exceeds working memory capacity.

layer2.mapping: Relates to GSE's reinforcement learning value functions; arousal modulates exploration-exploitation trade-offs.
layer2.telemetry: Heart rate variability and skin conductance responses
